Biographie

N\u00e9 en 1961 sur la plan\u00e8te 325, Luc Falotier commence sa carri\u00e8re comme allumeur sur une petite plan\u00e8te qui tournait si vite qu\u2019il rallumait son r\u00e9verb\u00e8re toutes les minutes.

Dipl\u00f4m\u00e9 de l\u2019\u00c9cole nationale des lanternes, il entre au minist\u00e8re en 1989 comme ing\u00e9nieur de l\u2019\u00e9clairage. Il dirige ensuite le service de l\u2019allumage, o\u00f9 il conduit le plan de r\u00e9novation des lanternes \u00e0 gaz, puis devient directeur des plan\u00e8tes en 2015.

Il est nomm\u00e9 ministre des Lampadaires et des Plan\u00e8tes le 3 mars 2024.

Parcours

  • 2024 : ministre des Lampadaires et des Plan\u00e8tes ;
  • 2015-2024 : directeur des plan\u00e8tes ;
  • 2003-2015 : chef du service de l\u2019allumage ;
  • 1989-2003 : ing\u00e9nieur de l\u2019\u00e9clairage ;
  • 1982-1989 : allumeur sur la plan\u00e8te 329.

Biographie

N\u00e9 en 1961 sur la plan\u00e8te 325, Luc Falotier commence sa carri\u00e8re comme allumeur sur une petite plan\u00e8te qui tournait si vite qu\u2019il rallumait son r\u00e9verb\u00e8re toutes les minutes.

Dipl\u00f4m\u00e9 de l\u2019\u00c9cole nationale des lanternes, il entre au minist\u00e8re en 1989 comme ing\u00e9nieur de l\u2019\u00e9clairage. Il dirige ensuite le service de l\u2019allumage, o\u00f9 il conduit le plan de r\u00e9novation des lanternes \u00e0 gaz, puis devient directeur des plan\u00e8tes en 2015.

Il est nomm\u00e9 ministre des Lampadaires et des Plan\u00e8tes le 3 mars 2024.

Parcours

  • 2024 : ministre des Lampadaires et des Plan\u00e8tes ;
  • 2015-2024 : directeur des plan\u00e8tes ;
  • 2003-2015 : chef du service de l\u2019allumage ;
  • 1989-2003 : ing\u00e9nieur de l\u2019\u00e9clairage ;
  • 1982-1989 : allumeur sur la plan\u00e8te 329.

Bienvenue sur le site du minist\u00e8re des Lampadaires et des Plan\u00e8tes

Le minist\u00e8re veille \u00e0 ce que chaque plan\u00e8te habit\u00e9e dispose d\u2019un \u00e9clairage public fiable, allum\u00e9 et \u00e9teint aux heures fix\u00e9es par la consigne.

"}, {"id": "ad45002c-95ba-4264-8911-09d561d8a150", "type": "image", "value": {"image": {"image": 112, "alt_text": "Vue nocturne de l\u2019Europe de l\u2019Ouest depuis l\u2019espace : les lumi\u00e8res des villes et des c\u00f4tes de l\u2019Espagne, de la France et de l\u2019Italie, sous la fine ligne bleue de l\u2019atmosph\u00e8re.", "decorative": false}, "width": "", "image_ratio": "fr-ratio-3x2"}}, {"id": "9f5f7113-416e-46e8-b80d-00cebc2f5434", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Retrouvez nos missions, les horaires d\u2019allumage de votre plan\u00e8te et nos derni\u00e8res actualit\u00e9s.

"}]

[{"id": "1c6a7dae-6246-44a2-a4d7-9b6a0ccf9d1b", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Missions, organisation et implantations du minist\u00e8re des Lampadaires et des Plan\u00e8tes.

"}, {"id": "25057b02-f234-484a-91bd-641760133194", "type": "subpageslist", "value": null}]

[{"id": "80454c55-a61b-4298-abb0-26e3c6445e04", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Le minist\u00e8re des Lampadaires et des Plan\u00e8tes exerce trois missions :

  • installer et entretenir les r\u00e9verb\u00e8res sur les plan\u00e8tes habit\u00e9es ;
  • fixer la consigne d\u2019allumage et d\u2019extinction ;
  • former et accompagner les allumeurs.
"}, {"id": "f1aca24f-3b05-4dbd-9a33-4b49f6b7dda6", "type": "image", "value": {"image": {"image": 107, "alt_text": "Lithographie : un allumeur en tablier, debout sur une rue pav\u00e9e, pr\u00e9pare la lanterne d\u2019un r\u00e9verb\u00e8re descendue au bout de sa corde.", "decorative": false}, "width": "fr-content-media--sm", "image_ratio": "fr-ratio-3x4"}}, {"id": "dbead372-0dbe-49e3-a8bd-2113d31f22b3", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Il travaille avec le bureau des longitudes, qui calcule la dur\u00e9e des jours de chaque plan\u00e8te.

"}]

[{"id": "ff64bc5f-72b8-43e5-b7fc-75983bb65825", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Le minist\u00e8re comprend trois directions et un secr\u00e9tariat g\u00e9n\u00e9ral :

  • la direction de l\u2019allumage ;
  • la direction des plan\u00e8tes ;
  • la direction de l\u2019entretien des lanternes ;
  • le secr\u00e9tariat g\u00e9n\u00e9ral.
"}]

[{"id": "f4dd77e2-6fa2-4ef2-a3a1-53715fa8b835", "type": "imageandtext", "value": {"text": "

Luc Falotier

Ministre des Lampadaires et des Plan\u00e8tes depuis le 3 mars 2024.

Le ministre fixe la consigne d\u2019allumage et pr\u00e9side le conseil des allumeurs. Il re\u00e7oit le public le premier lundi de chaque mois, entre deux couchers de soleil.

", "image": {"image": 125, "alt_text": "Luc Falotier, assis \u00e0 son bureau devant une carte du syst\u00e8me solaire, porte \u00e0 la boutonni\u00e8re un insigne en forme de lampadaire.", "decorative": false}, "image_side": "left", "image_ratio": "4"}}, {"id": "bf087892-394c-4b79-8156-7e2b135934d6", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Biographie

N\u00e9 en 1961 sur la plan\u00e8te 325, Luc Falotier commence sa carri\u00e8re comme allumeur sur une petite plan\u00e8te qui tournait si vite qu\u2019il rallumait son r\u00e9verb\u00e8re toutes les minutes.

Dipl\u00f4m\u00e9 de l\u2019\u00c9cole nationale des lanternes, il entre au minist\u00e8re en 1989 comme ing\u00e9nieur de l\u2019\u00e9clairage. Il dirige ensuite le service de l\u2019allumage, o\u00f9 il conduit le plan de r\u00e9novation des lanternes \u00e0 gaz, puis devient directeur des plan\u00e8tes en 2015.

Il est nomm\u00e9 ministre des Lampadaires et des Plan\u00e8tes le 3 mars 2024.

Parcours

  • 2024 : ministre des Lampadaires et des Plan\u00e8tes ;
  • 2015-2024 : directeur des plan\u00e8tes ;
  • 2003-2015 : chef du service de l\u2019allumage ;
  • 1989-2003 : ing\u00e9nieur de l\u2019\u00e9clairage ;
  • 1982-1989 : allumeur sur la plan\u00e8te 329.
"}]

[{"id": "b06e97f6-8b3e-49e3-be7f-4c434f836c1c", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Le minist\u00e8re dispose d\u2019une antenne sur chaque plan\u00e8te habit\u00e9e. Les plus petites plan\u00e8tes sont rattach\u00e9es \u00e0 l\u2019antenne la plus proche.

"}]

[{"id": "d4d39a32-932c-4f99-a416-f337247c3361", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Horaires, signalements et d\u00e9marches aupr\u00e8s du minist\u00e8re.

"}, {"id": "ed18ac9d-7066-4442-a4fc-119cf918f4bf", "type": "subpageslist", "value": null}]

[{"id": "f7cf9d1d-755b-4c48-a9bd-7a153615039f", "type": "alert", "value": {"level": "info", "title": "Plan\u00e8te \u00e0 rotation rapide", "description": "Sur certaines petites plan\u00e8tes, le jour dure une minute : l\u2019allumeur rallume alors son r\u00e9verb\u00e8re toutes les trente secondes.", "heading_tag": "h2"}}, {"id": "7d9a7b7b-a440-45e7-be4c-93a5661ea7f1", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Les horaires d\u2019allumage d\u00e9pendent de la dur\u00e9e du jour sur chaque plan\u00e8te. Ils sont publi\u00e9s chaque mois par le bureau des longitudes.

Les r\u00e9verb\u00e8res sont allum\u00e9s au coucher du soleil et \u00e9teints \u00e0 son lever.

"}]

[{"id": "ecfa565f-136b-4410-a75c-44313e8b55cd", "type": "alert", "value": {"level": "warning", "title": "R\u00e9verb\u00e8re \u00e9teint en pleine nuit ?", "description": "Signalez-le dans l\u2019heure : l\u2019allumeur de votre plan\u00e8te intervient avant le prochain coucher de soleil.", "heading_tag": "h2"}}, {"id": "afbab972-4777-4750-8558-6a315ba72f94", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Indiquez la plan\u00e8te, l\u2019emplacement du r\u00e9verb\u00e8re et la nature de la panne : lanterne cass\u00e9e, m\u00e8che us\u00e9e ou r\u00e9verb\u00e8re qui ne s\u2019\u00e9teint plus.

"}]

[{"id": "615b3a4a-1327-4349-bece-7d468b17853c", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Toute plan\u00e8te habit\u00e9e peut demander l\u2019installation d\u2019un r\u00e9verb\u00e8re. La demande est faite par son habitant, ou par l\u2019un d\u2019eux s\u2019ils sont plusieurs.

  1. Remplissez le formulaire de demande.
  2. Un agent du minist\u00e8re visite la plan\u00e8te.
  3. Le r\u00e9verb\u00e8re est install\u00e9 dans un d\u00e9lai de trois rotations.
"}]

[{"id": "4a83523d-a459-4da0-81e6-ce688bad8879", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Le m\u00e9tier d\u2019allumeur demande de la rigueur : la consigne doit \u00eatre respect\u00e9e, m\u00eame quand la plan\u00e8te tourne de plus en plus vite.

Les candidatures sont ouvertes toute l\u2019ann\u00e9e.

"}]

[{"id": "564406d5-3f54-4d65-9978-92b9fc908542", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Ce site est partiellement conforme au r\u00e9f\u00e9rentiel g\u00e9n\u00e9ral d\u2019am\u00e9lioration de l\u2019accessibilit\u00e9 (RGAA).

"}]

[{"id": "5f0afc87-f5f6-47d1-8d47-21127b184dd8", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Welcome to the Ministry of Street Lamps and Planets

The ministry makes sure every inhabited planet has reliable street lighting, lit and put out at the hours set by the instructions.

"}, {"id": "85de500e-0be1-4052-94f7-63d3c3797317", "type": "image", "value": {"image": {"image": 112, "alt_text": "Vue nocturne de l\u2019Europe de l\u2019Ouest depuis l\u2019espace : les lumi\u00e8res des villes et des c\u00f4tes de l\u2019Espagne, de la France et de l\u2019Italie, sous la fine ligne bleue de l\u2019atmosph\u00e8re.", "decorative": false}, "width": "", "image_ratio": "fr-ratio-3x2"}}, {"id": "27d73702-fac7-48ae-93b5-c9b17f06678d", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Find out about our missions, the lighting schedule for your planet and our latest news.

"}]

[{"id": "820b844f-6fe0-4c88-862c-ebaf32265747", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Missions, organisation and locations of the Ministry of Street Lamps and Planets.

"}, {"id": "8be301a7-50e1-49fb-9a96-0a7e630caf3e", "type": "subpageslist", "value": null}]

[{"id": "03270d7a-e055-4027-b69b-ef5792952424", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

The Ministry of Street Lamps and Planets has three missions:

  • installing and maintaining street lamps on inhabited planets;
  • setting the lighting instructions;
  • training and supporting lamplighters.
"}, {"id": "a871322a-74aa-4f9c-90d1-30c17db3459e", "type": "image", "value": {"image": {"image": 107, "alt_text": "Lithographie : un allumeur en tablier, debout sur une rue pav\u00e9e, pr\u00e9pare la lanterne d\u2019un r\u00e9verb\u00e8re descendue au bout de sa corde.", "decorative": false}, "width": "fr-content-media--sm", "image_ratio": "fr-ratio-3x4"}}, {"id": "8c11bebe-0092-468b-a59b-52aae7b882cd", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

It works with the Longitude Office, which computes the length of the day on each planet.

"}]

[{"id": "561ccd0b-b154-4530-9f9a-6e6d6022390c", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

The ministry has three directorates and a general secretariat: lighting, planets, and lantern maintenance.

"}]

[{"id": "18ca337c-3394-4cbe-a835-aff518ae28db", "type": "imageandtext", "value": {"text": "

Luc Falotier

Minister of Street Lamps and Planets since 3 March 2024.

The minister sets the lighting instructions and chairs the lamplighters\u2019 council.

", "image": {"image": 125, "alt_text": "Luc Falotier, assis \u00e0 son bureau devant une carte du syst\u00e8me solaire, porte \u00e0 la boutonni\u00e8re un insigne en forme de lampadaire.", "decorative": false}, "image_side": "left", "image_ratio": "4"}}, {"id": "9eca7884-9483-4455-8909-3b52bf3f13f4", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Biography

Born in 1961 on planet 325, Luc Falotier began his career as a lamplighter on a small planet that spun so fast he relit his lamp every minute.

A graduate of the National School of Lanterns, he joined the ministry in 1989 as a lighting engineer, then headed the lighting service and the planets directorate before being appointed minister in 2024.

"}]

[{"id": "4af54157-ea1d-49ea-80b3-97dc209d4fdd", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

The ministry has an office on every inhabited planet. The smallest planets depend on the nearest office.

"}]

[{"id": "6fc7bae8-babf-44eb-bc3b-f1d977d7fbab", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Schedules, reports and procedures with the ministry.

"}, {"id": "e9e7dac1-8388-4951-951d-76940596dc8f", "type": "subpageslist", "value": null}]

[{"id": "f456a839-0a84-4734-b020-30018e4493bd", "type": "alert", "value": {"level": "info", "title": "Fast-spinning planets", "description": "On some small planets, a day lasts one minute: the lamplighter then relights the lamp every thirty seconds.", "heading_tag": "h2"}}, {"id": "719e8390-c594-44b0-96e5-10158e337680", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Lighting hours depend on the length of the day on each planet. They are published every month by the Longitude Office.

Street lamps are lit at sunset and put out at sunrise.

"}]

[{"id": "e7a1db77-68b2-4849-91b1-2071257cda8c", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Give the planet, the location of the street lamp and the type of fault.

"}]

[{"id": "b9ad6312-a875-4382-a199-9016e81fad7a", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Any inhabited planet can request a street lamp. An agent of the ministry visits the planet before installation.

"}]

fields.body:
[{"id": "d7caacaf-265d-419a-872a-569ba1b71a08", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Being a lamplighter takes discipline: the instructions must be followed, even when the planet spins faster and faster.

"}]

[{"id": "7f742204-bb47-46ac-ae18-4027cc1e8a04", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

This site is published by the Ministry of Street Lamps and Planets, a fictional administration created to test Sites Conformes.

"}]

[{"id": "72ea2ac4-c1a4-4b1d-ae80-defe7d73cb35", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

The Ministry of Street Lamps and Planets is committed to making its site accessible.

"}]

[{"id": "6d4442cb-1cb6-4ac3-b616-6c392bf410f6", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Les derni\u00e8res actualit\u00e9s du minist\u00e8re.

"}]

[{"id": "b6de9822-5bd6-4409-b16c-3b619e3ff6e8", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

The latest news from the ministry.

"}]

[{"id": "ee442c74-bda9-4912-9bf9-eaa60bf213c9", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

\u00c0 partir du 1er f\u00e9vrier, les r\u00e9verb\u00e8res seront allum\u00e9s dix minutes avant le coucher du soleil.

"}]

[{"id": "188079bd-a5a7-49d9-97f6-79b30e8ff690", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Le plan de r\u00e9novation a permis de remplacer mille lanternes us\u00e9es par des mod\u00e8les plus sobres.

"}]

[{"id": "be332297-3175-47b5-8221-6450d968a380", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Vingt postes d\u2019allumeur sont ouverts sur les plan\u00e8tes de la ceinture ext\u00e9rieure.

"}]

[{"id": "d8c0a81e-108b-4d01-9b95-9755971633cb", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Le minist\u00e8re et la direction g\u00e9n\u00e9rale du Recensement des \u00e9toiles r\u00e9duisent la lumi\u00e8re dirig\u00e9e vers le ciel.

"}]

[{"id": "3e47a758-1324-4ba8-b680-7c0de77af4bc", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

La plan\u00e8te B 612 re\u00e7oit son premier r\u00e9verb\u00e8re, install\u00e9 entre deux volcans.

"}]

[{"id": "76563538-d4df-4853-8bc9-1315d155a667", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Les horaires d\u2019\u00e9t\u00e9 s\u2019appliquent d\u00e8s le 1er juin sur les plan\u00e8tes de l\u2019h\u00e9misph\u00e8re nord.

"}]

[{"id": "c93811cd-277c-414a-8070-fa8b4797e197", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Le rapport annuel pr\u00e9sente l\u2019activit\u00e9 du minist\u00e8re et le nombre de r\u00e9verb\u00e8res allum\u00e9s chaque soir.

"}]

[{"id": "b039e6f4-017b-489b-ac0b-699b03fad43f", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Quelques plan\u00e8tes gardent leurs lanternes \u00e0 gaz, allum\u00e9es \u00e0 la main deux fois par jour.

"}]

[{"id": "dcd80bd1-999d-439f-9719-92328f5a7d1e", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Le 12 ao\u00fbt, les r\u00e9verb\u00e8res resteront \u00e9teints pour la nuit des \u00e9toiles.

"}]

[{"id": "e1e1c37f-0c18-4e96-91c0-0941abecae11", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

La formation dure trois jours et porte sur la consigne, la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 et l\u2019entretien des lanternes.

"}]

[{"id": "92d5df17-3f80-48cb-93ea-fdf89ae4a791", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

From 1 February, street lamps will be lit ten minutes before sunset.

"}]

[{"id": "43771c76-4ea2-478f-afdf-b5e0eb516505", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

The renovation plan replaced a thousand worn lanterns with more efficient models.

"}]

[{"id": "04eab0ac-8110-456e-9c9b-0be5d125dff4", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Twenty lamplighter positions are open on the planets of the outer belt.

"}]

[{"id": "9f4a39eb-23c4-48af-a05e-b13f3c78e009", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

The ministry and the Star Census Directorate are reducing light pointed at the sky.

"}]

[{"id": "52ecb452-15c0-4121-872d-02a2683b08a9", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

Asteroid B 612 gets its first street lamp, set between two volcanoes.

"}]

fields.hero: [{"id": "7b09a368-0413-4373-b5b4-0a301fb66fb1", "type": "old_hero", "value": {"header_image": {"image": 112, "alt_text": "Vue nocturne de l\u2019Europe de l\u2019Ouest depuis l\u2019espace : les lumi\u00e8res des villes et des c\u00f4tes de l\u2019Espagne, de la France et de l\u2019Italie, sous la fine ligne bleue de l\u2019atmosph\u00e8re.", "decorative": false}, "header_darken": true, "header_with_title": true}}]
fields.body:
[{"id": "71af5d19-cb69-4ebc-8e0b-3e1b2317bd2b", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

The summer schedule applies from 1 June on northern-hemisphere planets.

"}]

[{"id": "8f5204c1-25f3-4e9e-b2cc-13d129ffebe9", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

The annual report covers the ministry\u2019s work and the number of lamps lit each evening.

"}]

[{"id": "94ebf5b0-9214-4b99-80eb-a82db19cea20", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

A few planets keep their gas lamps, lit by hand twice a day.

"}]

[{"id": "31030e73-2216-419a-bf5c-e20e9698d936", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

On 12 August, street lamps will stay off for the night of the stars.

"}]

[{"id": "d2b9dcfa-0026-4b01-891e-6499e5cbf04d", "type": "paragraph", "value": "

The three-day course covers the instructions, safety and lantern maintenance.

"}]
